title: Outbox Is Locked
description: The mock outbox can show every user's email/SMS history — that's exactly the kind of thing a customer or driver shouldn't be able to browse for anyone but themselves, since there's no per-user filter enforced on it.
successCondition: GET /api/notifications/outbox as a logged-in customer (or driver, or dispatcher) returns 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN. The same call with a valid admin token returns 200 with a messages array.
hints: This route uses requireRole("admin") specifically, layered on top of the module-wide authenticate hook — dispatcher is NOT included here, unlike some other modules.
Register a dispatcher account specifically to confirm even that role is excluded, since dispatcher has broad access elsewhere in the API.
